@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _own_guard_calls(request, tmp_path_factory, monkeypatch):
    """Each test's own guard call-log folder (ACT-GUARD-CALLLOG-1; DEC-1108 (5), DEC-1109 (2)); made only when used."""
